features.name: PX4-style cascaded drone controller
features.notes: Velocity→attitude→rate→motor cascade with gimbal and zoom control. mas/037: SIYI A8 zoom model (slew clip + dead-time buffer + integrator + first-order lag + 0.1-level publish quantization). 2026-05-07: zoom-controller bug fixes — ring buffer depth ceil(...)+1 with clamp [0, depth-1] (prevents d=depth wrap-around to 0 delay); per-call CUDA sync removed via _dead_time_all_zero Python bool cache refreshed in _refresh_dead_time_steps; env-side reset now mirrors controller._zoom.zoom (quantized published) into self.zoom_level so the first observation post-reset is consistent with subsequent steps.

features.name: Multi-agent delay/staleness/dropout simulation
features.notes: Ringbuffer-based with timestamp guarantees. Fixed calling contract: advance/query split ensures idempotent multi-call per step. Stage order: staleness→latency→FOL→dropout. Ticket-015: continuous AoI — jittered capture timestamps propagated via explicit store() timestamp arg. Ticket-018: AgentStates.zero_() for buffer reuse, eliminates ~50 GPU allocs/step. Ticket-029: DelayPipelineV3 dual-cache advance(raw, noisy) with one shared delay realization; structurally fixes the shared-pipeline idempotency bug (reward/obs cached together on first advance). Bbox modeled as single field bboxes_2d with dual payload: raw=raycaster GT, noisy=detector-replicator output (mirrors raw when replicator disabled); one pipeline applies shared latency/staleness/dropout to both payloads. detection_pipeline_split flag removed. Regression test test_dual_cache.py locks in invariants; plot_dual_cache.py renders dual_cache_invariants.png. (2026-04-14)

features.name: Curriculum learning system
features.notes: Redesigned: decoupled agent velocity ramp (0-40k, 3→10m/s) from target motion (40k-120k). Observability phases pushed after target mastery (noise 120k, delay 140k+). Anti-forgetting: tau_zoom/max_lin_vel wide-range randomization. Ticket 034 VALIDATED+CLOSED (2026-05-19): per-(env, agent) effective-progress sampler `curriculum/progress_helper.py` drives anti-forgetting Uniform(0, global_p) sampling on max_lin_vel, gimbal-τ, gimbal+zoom dead-time, noise scale, dropout rate, delay mode, burst dropout. min_latency_steps=2 floor enforced via LatencyCfg.min_steps (now surfaced on DelaySystemKeyParams). _max_lin_vel curriculum + randomization compose multiplicatively (was: replace). 400k validation run 034_2026-05-18_11-45-45_ticket034_per_env_jitter completes cleanly with controllers healthy (KL in [0.022, 0.028], LR mostly at max, one transient dip to 0.001 at step 120k that recovers by 160k, std stable 0.28). Mean reward parity with fix2 (last-10 avg 2642 vs 2714, -2.7%); task-quality metrics improved (bbox_center +17.5%, collisions -53%, cbf_penalty -29%, pair_valid +2.7pp, track_lost -20%); action-smoothness penalties +35-40% (acceptable cost for wider env variance). Regression eval visibility ratios at 39k/99k/199k/399k env settings: 0.898/0.827/1.034/1.000 (all PASS ≥0.80 bar; pre-fix was 0.616/0.577/0.988/1.000). agent_400000.pt is the new iris_ma6 baseline. Use this checkpoint going forward. Backlog: FP/FN curriculum (Q6, separate ticket), delay-system runtime efficiency (Q13, separate), critic-only privileged obs (Q10, optional).

features.name: Full environment integration and training
features.notes: Obs: 31D ego (pos, vel, rpy, ang_vel_b, lin_acc_b, gimbal joints, ray_dir_w, combined_ang_vel_w, bbox_aoi, zoom, effective_hfov, bbox) + 16D*(N-1) inter-agent [+6D tri]. Ticket-012: added effective HFOV (1D, radians) to ego obs — physical quantity, deployment-ready from camera calibration (2026-04-09). Ticket-030: registered heading-frame v1 env as separate gym task (`Isaac-Iris-MA6-Direct-V1-v0`) and wired experiment/eval task selection so short A/B validation can target baseline vs v1 without code edits. (2026-04-15). 2026-05-07: asymmetric actor-critic — `cfg.enable_critic_continuous_zoom` (default False) auto-sets `state_space = obs_dim*N + 2*N` and the env's `_get_states()` returns concat(actor_obs) ++ [zoom_internal, zoom_target] per agent. Actor's per-agent obs unchanged (still sees quantized published zoom that hardware exposes); centralized MAPPO critic gets the privileged continuous zoom state via skrl's existing `env.state()` → infos plumbing in `multi_agent_train`. Motivation: with quantum=0.1 and max Δzoom_per_step≈0.08, the symmetric critic blurs V predictions across all internal states sharing a quantum bin; the asymmetric critic resolves them, sharpening V and temporal credit assignment for the integrator chain that produces a quantum crossing several steps after the action. Toggle is the next training experiment to run against the failing siyi_a8 + sum8/delta12 config that earlier collapsed.

features.name: Experiment registry, training runners, and evaluation pipeline
features.notes: 42 experiments (A1/A3/A4/A5/A6/A7/baselines/sweeps), 4 suites, metric tracker with CBF metrics, greedy baseline with gimbal tracking. Ported from iris_ma5, dropped MLP path. Ticket-030: ExperimentCfg now carries a `task` field; run/eval resolve task precedence as CLI `--task` > experiment task > default baseline task. Added `validation_obs_v1_short` for short heading-frame A/B validation. (2026-04-15). Ticket-033 (2026-05-09→2026-05-15, VALIDATED+CLOSED): MAPPO-RNN trainer fix — optimizer/scheduler ownership keyed by parameter-tensor identity (`mappo_rnn_groups.py` + `mappo_rnn.py` _update refactor with MEAN aggregation). Homogeneous shared models (current iris_ma6) collapse to one Adam + one KLAdaptiveLR; heterogeneous setups fall through to per-uid layout unchanged. Final solution required four pieces: (1) ownership grouping, (2) MEAN aggregation, (3) cfg-side band alignment (`agent.kl_threshold=0.04`, `scheduler.kl_threshold=0.02`, `kl_factor=2.0`, `lr_factor=1.25`, `min_lr=3e-4`, `max_lr=1.5e-3`), (4) `learning_epochs: 6 → 3` (the missing piece — pre-fix's 6 was tolerable only because of the bug's implicit damping). 2026-05-15 fix2 run validates: peak 5406 (pre-fix 4081, +32%), last-10-avg 2714 (pre-fix 1963, +38%), strictly better at every checkpoint, controllers in healthy regime throughout 400k (LR at max_lr=1.5e-3 all run, KL parks in [0.012, 0.028]), per-component wins: triangulation +40%, collision penalty 5.6x lower. Use fix2's agent_drone_X_final.pt as new baseline. 20 tests pass in scripts/reinforcement_learning/skrl/tests/.
